project.title: Urban solitary bee foraging
project.description: We sampled and identified the larval pollen found in the nests of four wild bee species (Chelostoma florisomne, Hylaeus communis, Osmia bicornis and Osmia bicornis). The pollen composition was obtained through DNA metabarcoding of the ITS2 marker.
